service.description:
Apply a DeviceConfig to a Device.
This service materializes the declared configuration values of a DeviceConfig onto an existing Device. It copies compatible DeviceConfig-level fields to the target Device and updates only existing device-bound Parameter rows that match source configuration parameters by parameterDefId and parameterAlias.
The service does not create ParameterDef rows, does not create missing Parameter(deviceId) rows, and does not write to the real physical device. It updates only Moqui-side Device and Parameter state.

service.description:
Run a device request. The implementation is the service in DeviceRequest.runServiceName, which implements run#DeviceRequestInternal: a protocol service of moqui-device-gateway or another component.
A DrtConfigWrite request without items, whose query is a DeviceRuleSet, exports that rule set: the recipe files of moqui.device.DeviceConfigServices.get#DeviceConfigExportFiles are sent as transferFiles. A write, recipe export or content transfer ends with notify#DeviceRequestResult.
Redundant destinations: after a completed DrtConfigWrite or DrtContentTransfer, the same files go to each active DeviceRequest of the same type whose parentRequestName is this request, for example the second PLC of a redundant pair. A failure there does not change this request's status: it is in secondaryResults and in the notification of that request.

parameter.name: transferFiles
parameter.description: DrtContentTransfer or DrtConfigWrite: files to send, each a Map with name and content (text) or bytes.

parameter.name: payload
parameter.description: DrtWrite without items: a message sent as it is, as JSON (an MQTT publication on the request topic).

parameter.name: secondaryResults
parameter.description: The redundant destinations: maps with requestName, status, transferredFiles and errorMessage.
